_readme: Ground truth that OpenStreetMap does not have. Edit this file by hand, then re-run:
Every entry is located by a lat/lng point. The pipeline snaps it to the nearest
street segment and applies the change to that WHOLE path, not just the segment,
because a locked gate or a dead lamp affects the whole stretch.
To get coordinates: open /map, turn on 'Inspect a path', and click. The toast
gives you a line you can paste straight into this file.
blocked   - paths that cannot actually be walked (locked gate, wall, staff-only,
construction). Removed from the graph entirely BEFORE the exposure
model runs, so foot traffic reroutes the way people really do.
lighting  - surveyed lit/unlit ground truth. Overrides both OSM and the seed.
landmarks - places OSM is missing. kind is 'hostel' (people start here) or
emergency - security posts, medical centre, wardens. Shown on the map and used
to tell a walker what is near their route.
